# Peptide Playbook
> AI-powered peptide research platform backed by 500+ published studies

Peptide Playbook is an evidence-based peptide education tool. Users get personalized compound ratings, dosing information, legal status updates, and research summaries for 45+ peptides including semaglutide, tirzepatide, BPC-157, GHK-Cu, and more.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://peptideplaybook.org
- Research Library: https://peptideplaybook.org/guides
- Peptide Calculator: https://peptideplaybook.org/tools/peptide-calculator

## Guide Topics
The Research Library contains 50+ evidence-based guides covering:
- GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide)
- Healing peptides (BPC-157, TB-500)
- Skin and anti-aging peptides (GHK-Cu)
- Growth hormone peptides (CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, Sermorelin)
- FDA legal status and compounding regulations (updated February 2026)
- Peptide reconstitution and dosing guides
- Safety profiles and side effect data
- Comparison guides (semaglutide vs tirzepatide, BPC-157 vs TB-500)

## About
Peptide Playbook does not sell peptides. It is an independent research and education platform. All information is sourced from peer-reviewed published studies. Evidence strength is rated on a 5-star scale from Preliminary to Strong.
